    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Issue" name="Issue capital call">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Collect_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>

        <bpmn:extensionElements>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinalizeDeadline_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
